MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000279
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01036925
HSBC BANK USA, N.A., AS TRUSTEE
FOR THE REGISTERED HOLDERS OF
RENAISSANCE HOME EQUITY LOAN
TRUST 2006-1, is the Plaintiff, and
JULIO BARRERA, ET ALS., are
Defendants, writ of execution for
the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 01/29/2026.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 8TH DAY of APRIL,
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty
o'clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the
afternoon of the said day, at the
Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Ave,
New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the BORO OF SOUTH PLAINFIELD,
in the County of Middlesex, and
State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 414 ELSIE
AVE, SOUTH PLAINFIELD, NJ 07080;
Tax Lot: 50; Block: 311;
Dimensions of Lot: 50 FEET WIDE BY
218 FEET LONG.
Nearest Cross Street: FRANK PLACE.
Estimated upset bid amount: $306,000.00, plus any additional sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: OCCUPIED.
*SUBJECT TO ANY UNPAID TAXES,
MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER
CHARGES, AND ANY SUCH TAXES,
CHARGES, LIENS, INSURANCE
PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES
MADE BY PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS
SALE. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE
TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON
THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER
OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR
HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN
BEING FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE
CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.
- 2026 Qtr 1 Due: 02/01/2026 $1,384.56 OPEN
- 2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $1,384.55 OPEN
- Sewer: So. Plainfietd Boro 2480
Plainfield Avenue South Plainfield,
NJ 07080 908-754-9000 Acct: 5527
0 01/01/2026 - 06/30/2026
$215.00 OPEN $400.00 OPEN PLUS
PENALTY.
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES
THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE
THROUGH PUBLICATION.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of TWO HUNDRED
SEVENTY NINE THOUSAND THREE
HUNDRED THREE DOLLARS AND
EIGHTY ONE CENTS ($279,303.81)
DOLLARS more or less, plus interest
together with the costs of this
sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE
SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF
ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
ROBERTSON, ANSCHUTZ, SCHNEID,
CRANE & PARTNERS, PLLC
130 CLINTON ROAD STE 202
FAIRFIELD, NJ 07004
Attorneys
Dated: 3/10, 3/17, 3/24, 3/31/2026
